title_as_printed: Measured Water Saturation Concentrations in Various Fluids

footnotes_as_printed.a: Where available, literature values are reported for comparison.

pressure_note: Fluid pressure monitored by an electronic transducer to +-1 bar; the paper does not say whether it is total pressure

value.what: water saturation concentration in the CO2-rich (supercritical) fluid, mol % H2O, measured by near-IR absorbance

value3.what: literature value for comparison (Ref. 4 for CO2: derived from mass spectrometric measurements)

composition.other_species: pure water (distilled, gas-free); no salt. Fluid phase is pure CO2 (rows 2-3), or the refrigerants R22 / R134a (out of scope)

skip_rows.reason: solvent is refrigerant R22 (chlorodifluoromethane), not an in-scope gas
solvent is refrigerant R134a, not an in-scope gas

conversion_needs: value printed in mol %: multiply by 0.01
second-phase composition not measured: the aqueous phase is assumed pure water
notes: Only rows 2 and 3 (CO2, 344.8 bar, 50 and 75 C) are in scope. All six printed rows are kept in the CSV. The text says water is quantified in the supercritical fluid at saturation (peak area plateau). The paper does not define the physical state of 'saturation' beyond that, and no standard conditions for gas volumes are used.
